title: Tata Steel shares slide nearly 2% as EU anti-dumping duty and bearish technicals weigh
dek: The European Commission has imposed a 9.5% duty on certain cold-rolled flat steel imports from India, weighing on Tata Steel's shares, according to The Hindu BusinessLine.
summary: According to The Hindu BusinessLine, Tata Steel shares slid nearly 2% as an EU anti-dumping duty and bearish technical indicators weighed on the stock. The publisher reports that the European Commission on November 16 imposed a 9.5% duty on certain cold-rolled flat steel imports from India, covering Tata Steel and JSW Steel among others. The excerpt does not give export volumes or the duration of the measure.
keyFacts: The European Commission imposed the duty on November 16
The duty is 9.5% on certain cold-rolled flat steel imports from India
Tata Steel and JSW Steel are among the companies covered
whyItMatters: An anti-dumping duty on Indian cold-rolled flat steel adds a further barrier to one of India's important export destinations for value-added products. It could reduce the competitiveness of Indian mills in Europe.
implications: Indian exporters may need to redirect cold-rolled volumes to the domestic market or other regions, which could add pressure on domestic flat steel prices. European buyers may look to alternative suppliers.
